quirks.summary: Portal URL and vendor come from PlanIt's directory; neither the vendor nor any retrieval step has been verified against this portal.
quirks.detail: PlanIt reports scraper_type 'Arcus'. That label is a hint, not a finding - it is recorded elsewhere in this skill as stale at one authority and wrong at another. Fingerprint the portal before choosing a recipe, and set portal.vendor_verified when you have.
quirks.workaround: Run the vendor detection signatures in vendors.json against the portal before applying any recipe.

quirks.summary: Salesforce Experience site with no anonymous API surface; the landing page serves normally but there is nothing to call.
quirks.detail: The 200 is a Lightning shell, not data. bot_protection is deliberately null: nothing is challenging the client, so recording a block would be wrong and would imply a workaround exists. The obstacle is architectural.
quirks.workaround: Do not construct a recipe. Hand the user the browser route.

browser_route.note: Open the register in a browser. Record ids are Salesforce 18-character ids and cannot be constructed from a planning reference; PlanIt's applics `url` carries a ready-made deep link where it has one.

verification.note: Landing-page survey 2026-09-16: HTTP 200; vendor confirmed by fingerprint (arcus-salesforce)
Landing-page survey: HTTP 200 Lightning shell. No anonymous API (established at another Arcus install).
